summary: V1 lineups respond to left/right key direction and keep distinct drink-colored fields. The staggered trio still fans its light outward; V2's single parallel-direction clause does not consistently fix this. Start review with the V1 pair and left/right trios. Fine mesh and some cup-shape drift remain; these are research candidates, not approved customer results.

runs.v1_pair_staggered_left: Direct review: cola front-left and amber back-right, upright complete cups with recognizable ice, syrup and cream. Amber casts brighter gold; cola has a darker warm field with localized red. Principal fields run lower-right and the background is clean. Pale floor patterning to the left is not clearly tied to either cup. Fine webbing remains; exact cup proportions are not established.
runs.v1_trio_lineup_left: Direct review: red/orange/amber order and the new upright orange source are preserved. All three fields start at cup bases and extend lower-right; red/coral, orange-gold and darker amber are distinguishable. The distant background is clean. Repeated polygonal caustic cells and bright junctions remain, with small rim/cream changes.
runs.v1_trio_lineup_right: Direct review: same drink order with fields extending lower-left, as requested for a camera-right key. Colors remain red/coral, orange and amber, and the background stays clean. This demonstrates directional response in one sample per condition, not a controlled pixel-matched relight. Fine mesh and local star-like junctions persist; faint floor patterning extends beyond the dominant fields.
runs.v1_trio_orange_front: Direct review: orange is front-center with red and amber behind, and all cups are upright. However, the red field and much of the orange light splay lower-left while the amber field goes lower-right, violating the one-direction requirement. The source-like syrup/toppings remain recognizable, with a slightly enlarged foreground rim and an added orange bottom edge/ring. Dense webbing remains. V2 specifically tests the direction failure.
runs.v1_five_staggered: Direct review: five distinct drinks with clear/red, red, amber, cola and upright orange identities; bases are grounded and main shadow axes extend lower-right. Clear liquid casts a pale field with local red, cola a darker warm field, and amber/orange stronger gold. Some foreground widths increase and amber/cola rear contours are occluded. Fine mesh and broad pale floor light remain. No wall projection or imported blue drink color is evident.
runs.v2_trio_orange_front: Direct review: source identities, upright orange and clean distant background remain recognizable. Amber and the main orange footprint extend lower-right, but a large red/pale field still spreads lower-left from the rear red cup and across the left side of the orange cup. The added direction clause did not reliably remove outward splaying. Fine webbing and star-like focal points remain. No clear fidelity advantage over V1 is established.
runs.v2_five_staggered: Direct review: all five drinks are complete and grounded, with distinct pale/red/amber/dark-cola/orange identities. Layout changes to three rear/two front cups, confounding comparison to V1. Clear/red at the far left casts a conspicuous lower-left field while the main red and cola projections extend lower-right. The direction clause therefore does not reliably enforce a shared downstream axis. Occluded rear contours and some foreground enlargement limit geometry evaluation; dense branching mesh remains.
